title: iss signal
description: International Space Station sub-satellite point from wheretheiss.at, fetched every 10 s. GET /api/signals/iss, polled every 10 s; 404 unless providers.iss.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. Widgets compute alt/az for the observer themselves. Not sensitive.

lat.description: Latitude of the point below the ISS, degrees.

ts.description: Position time (upstream timestamp). Unix time in seconds (float).
